component.name: Media Metadata Wizard
component.summary: Edit tags, artwork, chapters and tracks of MP4 and Matroska files

description.p: Media Metadata Wizard edits the metadata of MP4 (M4V, M4A, M4B) and Matroska (MKV, MKA, WebM) files without re-encoding: iTunes-style tags, cover art, chapters, track names, languages, alternate groups, fallbacks and accessibility characteristics. A batch queue applies the same changes to many files.
